current.text: He signed a 3-year, 45 million contract with the Spurs.
He is not in the projected Spurs starting five of Fox, Castle, Vassell, Harris and Wembanyama. Tobias Harris takes the forward spot that Harrison Barnes held.
The Spurs roster is very deep at guard and forward. Dylan Harper needs minutes, and Champagnie competes with Harris, Vassell, Harper and Barnes for wing and forward minutes.
Experts say it is unclear where his minutes will come from with Dylan Harper and Tobias Harris on the roster.
He is not a must-draft. He needs a couple of injuries ahead of him to become one. People may reach for him anyway.
His rim finishing is not expected to stay this high, which puts his FG% at risk.
The Spurs are expected to make consolidation trades from their forward depth in the relatively near future, but not right now.

durable.text: He is an undersized power forward.
Teams with frontcourt size can hurt him on the glass.
He finished 71% at the rim last season. That is unusually high for a perimeter player.

note: He sits right at the edge of our 144-player draft: Yahoo rank 179 and value 0 USD, ESPN rank 111 and value 2 USD, and nobody drafted him in our league last season. At 1 USD he adds some threes (2.3 per game), FT% and low turnovers, but his FG% (43%) and assists are below the pool. Before the draft he is best left to waivers or taken as a last-round flyer. Early in the season, watch whether he gets starting power forward minutes over Harris and how many minutes he loses to Harper.
